source_name: EUR-Lex legislation in force — explicit Formex 4 mathematical formulas

official_access.access_mode: official EU Login-authenticated Data Dump bulk export in FMX/Formex XML, per language; no page-by-page scraping
official_access.fallback: CELLAR direct API is an official large-volume route when a Data Dump export is not suitable, but a snapshot must still be enumerated and content-addressed before ingestion

scope.collection: EUR-Lex legislation in force, CELEX sector 3
structures: equations, inequalities and mathematical expressions represented by EXPR/OP.CMP
fractions, roots, integrals, sums, functions and other structured Formex mathematical operators inside FORMULA
scope.original_representation: lexically preserved FORMULA XML subtree plus CELEX/document provenance and nearby legal context
exclusions: No reconstruction of prose thresholds, tables or legal rules in this lane
No claim that normalized or rendered notation is the original source notation
No automatic publication of records that fail the rights gate

snapshot_policy.rule: Treat one completed Data Dump download request for one language/export generation as the acquisition unit. Preserve the provider request/export metadata outside Git, inventory the exact downloaded ZIP/XML objects with byte sizes and SHA-256, sort deterministically by path, and use inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. A request id or wall-clock date alone is not a snapshot identity.

license_policy.rule: EUR-Lex permits reuse within copyright conditions and EU publications can contain third-party material. Preserve CELEX/document attribution and observed rights metadata. Do not publish raw Data Dump packages. Publish only derived occurrence Parquets whose reuse has passed the applicable rights check; otherwise retain checksums, provenance and index metadata only.

adapter.input: downloaded FMX/Formex XML files or ZIP packages from an official bulk route
validation: FORMULA is an explicit Formex element documented as mathematical formula/expression
Lexical FORMULA subtree is preserved rather than regenerated from parsed XML
CELEX number, language, source object, document SHA-256 and structural locator are retained when available
No OCR, reconstruction, normalization or equation-family assertion occurs in extracted stage
Raw/parsed FORMULA counts must agree; mismatch rejects the document instead of silently rewriting provenance
